title: DamageAssessment
description: Shape of a single-image analysis result. Mirrors com.cardamage.model.DamageAssessment / Damage. Used as the reference contract for the prompt sent to Claude Vision, and for manual review - NOT wired up as automatic JSON Schema validation in the Java code (validation there is done by DamageResponseValidator via Bean Validation annotations on the POJOs, see that class's javadoc for why).

status.description: success = real analysis result. error = valid JSON returned after retries were exhausted; damages is empty and overall_score is 0, but this does NOT mean 'no damage found'.

bounding_box.description: [x, y, width, height] in pixel coordinates. Used only for benchmark IoU matching against CarDD ground truth, not required for the demo scenario.
